'''House Damara''' is one of the known [[Nobility|Noble]] [[House]]s of [[Tear]], and is one of the most influential houses in the nation.

== House members ==
* High Lord [[Astoril Damara]], born in {{ne|935}}, now retired.
** His first wife, born in {{ne|940}}, who he married in {{ne|960}}, and who died in childbirth in {{ne|974}}.
*** His elder son, who died in the [[Aiel War]] aged seventeen.
*** His younger son, who died of sickness.
*** His elder daughter, now a High Lady of Tear and High Seat of House Damara.
*** His younger daughter.
** His second wife, who he remarried to in {{ne|979}}.
*** His daughter, [[Medore Damara]], now a warrior of ''[[Cha Faile]]''.
*** Two sons from his second wife.
